subject: french
title: Basic Colours
welcome_lead: Rouge, bleu, vert — colours in French.
final_note: Colour vocab — useful for clothes, food, anything.

walkthroughs.body_html: Noir = black. Blanc = white. When describing feminine nouns, blanc becomes blanche. Most colours change too — vert/verte.
